You buy an Emirates Ticket for AED 2,000
Call us on 800 4949 and ask us to redeem your points for cashback, after you have purchased your ticket
Is there a minimum spend requirement to avail the complimentary round of golf and Warehouse Gym access?
Yes, a minimum spend of AED10,000 or more every month is required for the cardholder to avail the complimentary round of golf at partner golf clubs and Warehouse Gym access.
Golf: If the minimum spend requirement is not met, a fee of AED525 will be applicable. Golf privileges are subsided by Standard Chartered Bank and not a direct offer from the golf clubs.

Warehouse Gym: If the minimum spend requirement is not met, a fee of AED525 will be applicable. Cardholders will be requested to charge their Journey credit card for AED1 for every visit to a Warehouse Gym outlet which will be reversed in the following statement

Airport Lounge Terms and Conditions7

Your airport lounge benefits with your Visa credit card will only be accessible exclusively through the Visa Airport Companion (VAC) app and will replace the current process of accessing airport lounges by just presenting your physical credit card.
Download and register with your Standard Chartered credit card on the Visa Airport Companion app to check your lounge access eligibility and personal benefits.

First two visits to the airport lounges in a calendar year is complimentary. To utilise the subsequent unlimited complimentary unlimited visits in the same calendar year, a client needs to make a minimum international spend of USD 1 or equivalent.
Any visits beyond the 2 complimentary visits and if the spend criteria is not met, then the cardholder will be charged $32 per usage on the used card.
The annual lounge visit entitlement and the requirement to meet the eligibility condition will reset from 1 January in subsequent years.
As part of the default option, any lounge visits outside Visa Lounge entitlement will need to be paid for by the Cardholder (Visit will be charged directly to the card by Visa)
